title: A slow VoiceStudio never ends the session for held speech, and a language rescue replays before live audio
steps: S1: speech while VoiceStudio finishes a phrase overflows its hold.
S2: through the real relay on a slow VoiceStudio.
S3: a rescue on the profile path with live frames before session_started.
expect: S1: bounded memory, no provider failure, newest audio kept in order.
S2: both phrases kept; ends stopped, settled false.
S3: replay first, then live frames in order.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: queue_overflow ended the session as provider; after a rescue live frames could reach the service ahead of the replay
fence: Held audio is bounded and never a provider failure; a replay is never overtaken

tests: VoiceStudio: speech while the server finishes a phrase is held within its bound; the session never fails for it
voice relay: a session on a slow VoiceStudio outlives a full hold, keeps both phrases, and ends unsettled — never as provider
a reopened session gets the replayed phrase before any live frame, also when audio waits for the service to start
